productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I bought this Zeagoo top for my wife, and it ended up being exactly what she was looking for. The fabric is comfortable, the style is versatile, and it looks great with jeans or shorts. The biggest pro is the length—it isn't too short or too long, which can be hard to find. The fit is flattering, and the quality is better than expected for the price. The only con is that the color was slightly different than it appeared online, but not enough to be a problem. Overall, she loves it, and it's become one of her go-to casual tops.

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: ★★★★☆ Really Cute Top, But Definitely Runs Big!I really like this top overall! The pattern is cute, the material is comfortable, and it has that nice in-between style where you can dress it up for work but still wear it casually with jeans or shorts. The cap sleeves and neckline are flattering, and it looks put together without feeling overly dressy.The biggest thing to know before ordering is that it runs BIG. I definitely would have preferred a smaller size for a more flattering fit. The extra room makes it comfortable, but it also makes the shirt look a little looser and boxier than I expected based on the pictures.Other than the sizing, I really don't have any complaints. It's lightweight enough for warmer weather, comfortable to wear for an entire workday, and easy to pair with different pants or accessories. I especially like having tops like this that look professional enough for work without feeling stiff or uncomfortable.I'm giving it four stars because I genuinely like the shirt, but the sizing could be more accurate. If you're between sizes or prefer your tops a little more fitted, I would recommend sizing down.

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Size medium fits well. I’m 5’5”, 135 lbs, and 34A chest. It’s loose fit just like I wanted. productPageReviews.reviewDescription: These summer tank tops are beautiful! They are so light and a soft material! You can wear them out in the front, or tucked in of whatever you’re wearing! They go well with shorts, capris, jeans etc. The V-neckline sits perfectly without being cut too high or too low. Under arm area is perfectly cut as well. I like when the underarm comes up high enough to cover the bra! It’s hard to find tops like these that are comfortable, breathable and cut to fit the neckline, tummy area, and under arm. These are made well too! They aren’t stretchy, just a nice breathable, flowing, and lightweight soft material. The patterns, & colors are beautiful, and there are a lot to pick from. I’m just very pleased with these, especially for the price as well. You can even wear these in the Spring and Fall time too, because a light sweater, or cardigan will go well with these too! I bought 2, and I ordered 2 more, as soon as I wore them. Very nice!

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: The printed tops I ordered were exactly what was pictured.  The size was perfect and flattering to my chubby figure.  The tops are extremely comfortable.  They looked just fine and felt good even in damp and humid weather with 90 plus degrees.  They are easy care.  If traveling, they can be washed in a sink and hung up to dry.  One important thing for me is I feel comfortable wearing them working in my home and outside in my garden.  They don't show dirt and I still look good.  I give them a top review.  The tops are stylish, cute, fun to wear, easy to pack, and requires little care.  The price is RIGHT!

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I bought 5 or 6 of these tops in a variety of patterns and colors to get me through the summer. They're nice but expect smaller than US sizing by about 1 or 1 1/2 sizes. I ordered a larger size with that in mind and it fits to my body with no "loose fit" as shown in the advertisement.The tag on the inside left is extremely annoying and just happens to be the best sewn piece, so remove with care or you'll have a hole in the seam. Ask me how I know.The material has a bit of stretch and is somehow softer to the touch on the outside than on the inside.Other than that, they're comfortable enough, lightweight but kept their shape and size when laundered, nice colors and patterns. One of the tops was a little more vibrant in color than pictured, but overall a good purchase for the price considering I didn't need to drive from store to store trying to find summer tops. Consider the source and look for a few loose threads. Expect shipping delays with customs. My tops came in 3 different shipments over time.

The fabric is stretchy, which helps the snug fit feel flexible and easy to move in. The white color is slightly see‑through, which is typical for lightweight materials like this.The sleeves can be pushed up for a 3/4‑length look. The model normally wears a size large and ordered an XL for a looser fit, and it fit exactly as expected. It comes in a variety of colors and works well both on its own and as a layering piece.Care instructions are simple: machine wash but do not tumble dry to help preserve the fabric and shape. Overall, it’s a good quality, comfortable, stretchy, versatile tee and a good value.

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: ★★★★☆ Really Cute Top, But Definitely Runs Big!I really like this top overall! The cap sleeves and neckline are flattering, and it looks put together without feeling overly dressy.The biggest thing to know before ordering is that it runs BIG. I definitely would have preferred a smaller size for a more flattering fit. The extra room makes it comfortable, but it also makes the shirt look a little looser and boxier than I expected based on the pictures.Other than the sizing, I really don't have any complaints. It's lightweight enough for warmer weather, comfortable to wear for an entire workday, and easy to pair with different pants or accessories. I especially like having tops like this that look professional enough for work without feeling stiff or uncomfortable.I'm giving it four stars because I genuinely like the shirt, but the sizing could be more accurate. productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Soft, Flattering and So Easy to Wear!Soft, Flattering and So Easy to Wear!
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: This top is such a great combination of comfort and looking put together! The fabric is incredibly soft, with plenty of stretch. It is very forgiving without looking oversized or frumpy. I also love that it doesn’t wrinkle easily, which makes it perfect for work and busy days.The brown color is beautiful. It’s a warm terracotta shade and looks even prettier in person. The gathered sleeve detail is super fun!! They add just enough personality to make it look dressy without being over the top.I’ve already gotten compliments when wearing it, and it has quickly become one of those tops I reach for when I want to look polished but still feel completely comfortable. Definitely one of my favorite work tops!

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Super cute top and perfect for fall temps! The fabric is extremely soft and has a great weight to keep you cozy but not too hot. The puffy shoulders translate even better once you’ve received it and able to try it on for size. I also love that the back is a bit longer than the front as well. The sizing runs true-to-size — or if anything, slightly larger — which is what I hoped for. I like my tops to run a tad big, so all is not lost if it ends up in the dryer. I’m 5ft 6” and 130lbs and chose a large; but also certain a medium would fit fine. I’m want a couple more in a few other colors, because I can tell this will be one of my favorite go-to staples (especially because the flattering shape will dress-up just fine for work, and be darling with shorts or a casual mini skirt for running errands.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: My Go-To Brand!!!  Affordable, Comfy, and So Chic!My Go-To Brand!!!  Affordable, Comfy, and So Chic!
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I am one of Dokotoo’s biggest fans! Every single piece of clothing I’ve gotten from them has been amazing quality; everything fits beautifully and feels incredible. When you find a brand this good, you stick with them… and this is definitely one of those brands.I needed a top to wear with a pair of paperbag-style pants and picked up this one. I read the reviews recommending to size up, and I’m so glad I did, the fit was perfect.  I wear a medium and I am 5'3" and 163 pounds.  The material is a lightweight sweater knit that’s sooo soft and not see-through at all. It totally finished off my outfit, and I was comfortable all day. Honestly, it felt like wearing pajamas!I got so many compliments when I wore it. Highly recommend this top and the brand in general. I’m obsessed… and so is my wallet! 😂

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: At first I wore this with denim pants, and the shirt caught all the wrong grooves. productPageReviews.reviewDescription: It’s cute. And I love that it’s modest! But it was just long on me. That’s not typically an issue I have with shirts. But I will say that I am very short. productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I absolutely love these dress shirts and have already purchased them in three different colors because they are just that good. Finding a shirt that is both comfortable and flattering can be difficult, but these checked every box for me. The sizing is true to size, and for reference, I am 5’2”, 137 pounds, and the medium fits perfectly without being too tight or too loose. The fabric is soft, lightweight, and comfortable enough to wear all day, while still looking polished and professional. Even though the material is not heavy, the shirts are very well made and do not feel cheap at all. They instantly dress up an outfit whether paired with jeans for a casual look or slacks for work or dinner. One of the things I appreciate most is how well they hold up after washing. I have washed mine multiple times already, and they still look great with no shrinking, fading, or loose stitching. Honestly, these shirts look far more expensive than they actually are, making them an excellent value for the price. I would absolutely recommend them and will probably buy even more colors in the future.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: My new Favourite Summer Tank Top - padded cup (no shelf bra!)My new Favourite Summer Tank Top - padded cup (no shelf bra!)
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Cutest tank top, my new summer go-to.  I was looking and searching high and low for a tank top which had padded cups without the shelf bra.  Shelf bras are so uncomfortable with their elastic bands and are even worse in the summer, sweaty sun.  I wanted something breathable, movable, and with just a bit of padding to cover the nipples and add the slightest big of shape.  If you are large breasted these built in cups might not be the best for you, but as a smaller breasted lady these are perfect.  The cups are not over the top bulky, but also they are not meant to really add "support" (for those who are looking for support this wouldn't be the tank for you.  Think lightly padded!)  The material is super soft and the length comes down to the hips.  The tank doesn't ride up, so you're not always having to pull them down and adjust, and so you could wear them for both workouts or for casual summer evenings.  I bought size XS and I am 5'1, 97 lbs.  I was wondering if I should go to a size S because it wasn't clear by some of the reviews, but I'm glad I bought the XS because the shoulder strap is also the perfect length (not too baggy but also not super tight).  Read the sizing chart before you buy - they are true to the size indicated on the sizing chart.  Some have said theirs didn't come with padding, or the stitching was poor, but the ones I've received are totally fine.  This tank is just plain-old comfortable any way you look at it.  I'll be buying more colours!

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Super happy I bought with these!!
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: These summer tank tops are beautiful! They are so light and a soft material! You can wear them out in the front, or tucked in of whatever you’re wearing! They go well with shorts, capris, jeans etc. The V-neckline sits perfectly without being cut too high or too low. Under arm area is perfectly cut as well. I like when the underarm comes up high enough to cover the bra! It’s hard to find tops like these that are comfortable, breathable and cut to fit the neckline, tummy area, and under arm. These are made well too! They aren’t stretchy, just a nice breathable, flowing, and lightweight soft material. The patterns, & colors are beautiful, and there are a lot to pick from. I’m just very pleased with these, especially for the price as well. You can even wear these in the Spring and Fall time too, because a light sweater, or cardigan will go well with these too! I bought 2, and I ordered 2 more, as soon as I wore them. Very nice!

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I bought 5 or 6 of these tops in a variety of patterns and colors to get me through the summer. They're nice but expect smaller than US sizing by about 1 or 1 1/2 sizes. I ordered a larger size with that in mind and it fits to my body with no "loose fit" as shown in the advertisement.The tag on the inside left is extremely annoying and just happens to be the best sewn piece, so remove with care or you'll have a hole in the seam. Ask me how I know.The material has a bit of stretch and is somehow softer to the touch on the outside than on the inside.Other than that, they're comfortable enough, lightweight but kept their shape and size when laundered, nice colors and patterns. One of the tops was a little more vibrant in color than pictured, but overall a good purchase for the price considering I didn't need to drive from store to store trying to find summer tops. Consider the source and look for a few loose threads. Expect shipping delays with customs. My tops came in 3 different shipments over time.
productPageReviews.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on May 26, 2026

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: SMART SOLUTION for looking good whether working, traveling, entertaining, or just plain living.
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: The printed tops I ordered were exactly what was pictured.  The size was perfect and flattering to my chubby figure.  The tops are extremely comfortable.  They looked just fine and felt good even in damp and humid weather with 90 plus degrees.  They are easy care.  If traveling, they can be washed in a sink and hung up to dry.  One important thing for me is I feel comfortable wearing them working in my home and outside in my garden.  They don't show dirt and I still look good.  I give them a top review.  The tops are stylish, cute, fun to wear, easy to pack, and requires little care.  The price is RIGHT!

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I bought this Zeagoo top for my wife, and it ended up being exactly what she was looking for. productPageReviews.reviewDescription: ★★★★☆ Really Cute Top, But Definitely Runs Big!I really like this top overall! The pattern is cute, the material is comfortable, and it has that nice in-between style where you can dress it up for work but still wear it casually with jeans or shorts. The cap sleeves and neckline are flattering, and it looks put together without feeling overly dressy.The biggest thing to know before ordering is that it runs BIG. I definitely would have preferred a smaller size for a more flattering fit. The extra room makes it comfortable, but it also makes the shirt look a little looser and boxier than I expected based on the pictures.Other than the sizing, I really don't have any complaints. It's lightweight enough for warmer weather, comfortable to wear for an entire workday, and easy to pair with different pants or accessories. I especially like having tops like this that look professional enough for work without feeling stiff or uncomfortable.I'm giving it four stars because I genuinely like the shirt, but the sizing could be more accurate. If you're between sizes or prefer your tops a little more fitted, I would recommend sizing down.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Super happy I bought with these!!
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: These summer tank tops are beautiful! They are so light and a soft material! You can wear them out in the front, or tucked in of whatever you’re wearing! They go well with shorts, capris, jeans etc. The V-neckline sits perfectly without being cut too high or too low. Under arm area is perfectly cut as well. I like when the underarm comes up high enough to cover the bra! It’s hard to find tops like these that are comfortable, breathable and cut to fit the neckline, tummy area, and under arm. These are made well too! They aren’t stretchy, just a nice breathable, flowing, and lightweight soft material. The patterns, & colors are beautiful, and there are a lot to pick from. I’m just very pleased with these, especially for the price as well. You can even wear these in the Spring and Fall time too, because a light sweater, or cardigan will go well with these too! I bought 2, and I ordered 2 more, as soon as I wore them. Very nice!

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I bought 5 or 6 of these tops in a variety of patterns and colors to get me through the summer. They're nice but expect smaller than US sizing by about 1 or 1 1/2 sizes. I ordered a larger size with that in mind and it fits to my body with no "loose fit" as shown in the advertisement.The tag on the inside left is extremely annoying and just happens to be the best sewn piece, so remove with care or you'll have a hole in the seam. Ask me how I know.The material has a bit of stretch and is somehow softer to the touch on the outside than on the inside.Other than that, they're comfortable enough, lightweight but kept their shape and size when laundered, nice colors and patterns. One of the tops was a little more vibrant in color than pictured, but overall a good purchase for the price considering I didn't need to drive from store to store trying to find summer tops. Consider the source and look for a few loose threads. Expect shipping delays with customs. My tops came in 3 different shipments over time.
productPageReviews.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on May 26, 2026

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: These summer tank tops are beautiful! They are so light and a soft material! You can wear them out in the front, or tucked in of whatever you’re wearing! They go well with shorts, capris, jeans etc. The V-neckline sits perfectly without being cut too high or too low. Under arm area is perfectly cut as well. I like when the underarm comes up high enough to cover the bra! It’s hard to find tops like these that are comfortable, breathable and cut to fit the neckline, tummy area, and under arm. These are made well too! They aren’t stretchy, just a nice breathable, flowing, and lightweight soft material. The patterns, & colors are beautiful, and there are a lot to pick from. I’m just very pleased with these, especially for the price as well. You can even wear these in the Spring and Fall time too, because a light sweater, or cardigan will go well with these too! I bought 2, and I ordered 2 more, as soon as I wore them. Very nice!

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I bought 5 or 6 of these tops in a variety of patterns and colors to get me through the summer. They're nice but expect smaller than US sizing by about 1 or 1 1/2 sizes. I ordered a larger size with that in mind and it fits to my body with no "loose fit" as shown in the advertisement.The tag on the inside left is extremely annoying and just happens to be the best sewn piece, so remove with care or you'll have a hole in the seam. Ask me how I know.The material has a bit of stretch and is somehow softer to the touch on the outside than on the inside.Other than that, they're comfortable enough, lightweight but kept their shape and size when laundered, nice colors and patterns. One of the tops was a little more vibrant in color than pictured, but overall a good purchase for the price considering I didn't need to drive from store to store trying to find summer tops. Consider the source and look for a few loose threads. Expect shipping delays with customs. My tops came in 3 different shipments over time.

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I bought 5 or 6 of these tops in a variety of patterns and colors to get me through the summer. They're nice but expect smaller than US sizing by about 1 or 1 1/2 sizes. I ordered a larger size with that in mind and it fits to my body with no "loose fit" as shown in the advertisement.The tag on the inside left is extremely annoying and just happens to be the best sewn piece, so remove with care or you'll have a hole in the seam. Ask me how I know.The material has a bit of stretch and is somehow softer to the touch on the outside than on the inside.Other than that, they're comfortable enough, lightweight but kept their shape and size when laundered, nice colors and patterns. One of the tops was a little more vibrant in color than pictured, but overall a good purchase for the price considering I didn't need to drive from store to store trying to find summer tops. Consider the source and look for a few loose threads. Expect shipping delays with customs. My tops came in 3 different shipments over time.

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Bought the green agate color in size large. The color is beautiful and the material is nice. Soft, comfortable. productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Great shirt - Exactly what I expected
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: This is a lovely short sleeve button down blouse. It has a flattering cut, is sized accurately based on product measurements, and is a wash and wear material. I didn’t notice any real shrinkage - despite washing and drying at excessively high temperatures - and the fabric is soft and has a slight stretch. This blouse seems quite durable and seems to be a good quality product that is stitched well and is not see through, even in white. I would definitely purchase this again.

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Bought this for me for a nice summer blouse, and I love it! (I actually bought another one in a different pattern.) The size chart was off, as was Amazon's suggested size for me. I had to return and buy the next size up, so take that into account when ordering. (was to small in the bust) The fabric feels so soft and smooth, it seems to wash up well and resists stains, it is lightweight without being too thin or see through, and it pairs with so many of my other clothes. The colors were as expected, it doesn't seem to shrink with washing, but doesn't have any stretch, in case that's what you're looking for. I've worn these a lot already this summer, and always get compliments.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Good quality, a little off on fit.
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I got this shirt on sale for $14 so it was a great buy.  I'm 5'4', 38B/C, 164lb and got size Large.  I wanted something a little dressier than a t-shirt and not as form fitting. It fits just right in the bust with not much room to spare; the body is straight, boxy and short enough that it looks good untucked.  The quality seems excellent: well sewn seams, no loose threads on buttons, pattern (pink/white/charcoal vertical stripes) matched nicely down the front and on the collar.  I took a star off because the sleeves are set in quite low, like it was meant for someone with very broad shoulders.  The polyester fabric feels almost like nylon - it's slippery and noisy.  But given the surprisingly good construction quality and low price (even without the sale) I still recommend it.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Excellent quality and fit at a bargain priceExcellent quality and fit at a bargain price
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: This shirt for exceeded my expectations. The quality of the fabric is solid and wrinkle free. It is not that shiny fabric you see on so many shirts with this print, but it is a knit, matte finish. It is very lightly stretchy making it easy to pull on over your head. I find the medium to be a perfect fit and that is my usual size. It is not skin tight, but it also is not baggy. It is a relaxed fit that skims the body nicely. The stitching is well done and very even. The self fabric trim of the V-neck lays down flat. The arm holes are just right and do not hang and show your bra underneath. The fabric is not see-through so any color bra can be worn underneath, at least not in this particular print.I have not washed it yet and the car instructions say not to put it in the dryer. I can’t imagine why not. Since this is not a cotton fabric it will not shrink. I intend to dry it in the dryer on the medium setting. If that causes a problem, I will come back and state that in my review.I find the shirt to be a perfect length to wear untucked. It does not hang too far and yet it is not cropped too short. This particular print was less than $10 which I find to be quite the bargain considering the very nice quality of the fabric and the workmanship.I was looking for a lightweight top that I can pack when traveling that does not require ironing. I wanted it to be easy to hand wash which this will be. And I wanted a pattern so that if I happen to spill something on myself, it does not look like I am a mess. It is not always easy to wash clothes immediately while traveling. I’ll be able to hand wash this in a sink, ring it out in a towel, and hang it to dry overnight. It is nice enough to wear with a skirt for dinner and simple enough to wear with pants during the day.There’s nothing I don’t like about this great, well made, value priced top.

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: This short sleeve lightweight sweater is so comfortable and soft. It fits well through the shoulders and across the bust (actually very flattering) and drapes nicely down the midsection so it doesn't cling in the areas I like to camouflage. The sleeves are long enough to cover most of my upper arms and aren't too tight, which is something I appreciate as I get older. The length is perfect but may be a little long for shorter heights or short waisted figures. I love this sweater so much, I've purchased it in 3 colors! The colors are vibrant and will probably wash well since it's 100% viscose and I've purchased several tops in this fabric. I wash in cold water and tumble dry on low without any shrinkage or fading. No wrinkles if you hang it right away. Great value for the cost!!

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Great top- coming back for more!
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: This is a great, versatile “sweater.”  It’s not really sweater material though. It’s a thinner top, which was what I was looking for. It was be great to wear in spring and summer or as a layering piece in the fall. It would be nice under a blazer. It’s nice work or church top.I’m 5’5”, 174lbs and 36DD and I got the large, it fits great. It’s slightly long but that is good if you plan to tuck it in. It also has a band around the waist and end of the sleeves, so you can place the band where you want it at your waist and let it drape a bit… just slightly. Also, I’m a bit short waisted so it may not be as long on someone else. The sleeves are a nice, modest length and come to about 2 inches above my elbows.The fabric is not clingy and the apricot color wasn’t see through (with a skin color bra). It’s actually a very flattering fit.I was hoping for a cream or off white color, so I went with apricot and it’s really more of an almond color. I like the top and the apricot (almond) color is neutral, so I’ll keep it. Although, I’m coming back for the white color, and probably more.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: Well made, reasonably priced, goes well with jeans and pants.
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: I bought two of these tops for this summer and are happy with my purchases. They are true to size and color. The garments are well made however the fabric is a bit on the 'stiff' side, which means that the fabric is not the 'soft touch' type. Regarding sizing, although true to size, the style itself is considered (from my standard) relatively long and loose fit. I'm 5 ft. 3 inches, 115 lbs, wearing a small and the garment covers half of my buttock. Of course, how one likes the style is absolutely a personal preference. I purchased the dark purple and khaki and they are lovely. Great value. Highly recommend.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: Flattering, Lightweight and Versatile Knit Top
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: This is a beautiful lightweight knit short sleeve top. A perfect alternative to a regular cotton t-shirt in the summer. Size up if you want it loose, in which case it falls nicely without looking dumpy like a loose t-shirt can. Great for the office or simply elevating your casual wear. I wish they would make an elbow length variation. These are a bit long, but thin enough to roll under at your waist, tuck in your pants/shorts/skirt, or add a belt over top. Perfect layering piece that can be worn all seasons. I purchased in several colors.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: This is a very nice sweater to add to my wardrobe. The color is true on the one I ordered
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: This top is perfect as it fits me well and the fabric is so soft and is not itchy at all. It is smooth to the touch and is a very nice length not only on the body of the sweater but the sleeves are just the right length for me. The sleeves are about 9 1/2 inches from the shoulder to the bottom of the sleeve and the sleeve under the arm measures 3 3/4 inches from the body to the bottom edge of the sleeve. I ordered a medium so those ratios could change on smaller or larger sizes. There is no see-through to this top and hopefully there will be no shrinkage after I launder it. Others have said it doesn't shrink after washing. It is a beautiful sweater and hopefully it will last. I don't know how warm it will be but I think it is perfect for all year depending how one uses it. Perfect for spring through fall on nice days for sure just wearing it alone.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Good for petite women, perfect fit, very soft and lightweight
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I am a petite lady at 5'0 tall and 140 lbs for reference.  I bought this sweater in a medium, and it was a perfect fit.  Because I have a short torso, I have difficulty with shirts and sweaters because they are always to long if not in petite sizes...not this sweater, the length and overall fit was absolutely perfect!  The fabric is sweater like, but lightweight, and was no issue with 80 degree weather.  The feel is very soft, and not in the least itchy...it is extremely comfortable, and I love the coffee color.  I highly recommend this comfortable lightweight sweater.  I washed it in cold water on gentle cycle and then 10 minutes on lowest dryer setting, then finished with a hang dry....no shrinkage or pilling.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Nice top but need to size up!
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I ordered this top in my usual size in the beige with black pattern. I should have listened to some of the reviews that said that this top runs small. It does run small. That said, I still liked the top and wanted to try the next size up. I tried to request to simply exchange the top for the next size up but they said I would just have to return and re-order. I had gotten the first purchase on sale and the subsequent order cost me several dollars more. Aside from that, I received the new top and found it to fit me the way I had hoped for. I was happy with the way the top hung and did not cling. The material is nice and it doesn't look cheaply made, no loose threads and seams are straight/uniform. The pleating with buttons on the top is very pretty and lays nicely.  I would recommend this purchase, just pay attention to the sizing.Update 01/13/26: I bought a second one of these tops when it went on sale. I needed something with some sleeve length to it but I am one who can't stand the feel of long sleeves. This does the trick. Also what I like about these tops is that the neckline is reasonable and fits right, it does not sag way down like some tops do. The material is soft and not super thin or too thick. The pleated top is sewn very nicely and lays perfectly. It is an attractive touch on this blouse. I find it comfortable to wear in a casual setting or for dressing up.  For this top I ordered the one that the description says is green. It is not green, but more of an aqua color. Still, it is pretty and I chose to keep it. Again, I have to remind you to order up one size from your usual size.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Great Cut & Style! Well made 9-10 Season, Light Weight Sweater
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I received my Navy Blue XXL Dokotoo Womens Ladies Oversized Light Weight Sweater in today’s mail. I am 5’ & 175#’s. I held off ordering this for the longest time because of one review that said it was see thru. IT IS NOT SEE THRU. The part right above where the top of your bra sits is a more open weave of fabric and you can see your bra straps if you wear a light colored bra. I will wear a black bra so fit me- it will not be an issue. The top is well made and the dark blue has some life in it. I am very fair and look terrible in black. The material is very soft and while it does not cling to real women’s lumps and bumps- my spare tire is evident. I just have to keep working off all that ice cream I have over-indulged on… Anyway, the material is medium weight and not too thick. The feeling on the skin is perfect. I live in the Deep South and this is easily a 9-10 month top. It could easily become a year round top with a light weight sweater or heavier- depending how your body runs. Perfect for work; worship; date night; dinner out with the gals/hens. It would make a lovely gift for moms; daughters; granddaughters; best friends; etc;. Perfect addition to anyone wardrobe. The price is very fair for this type of light weight sweater in my humble opinion. If your on the fence- add one to your cart. You will not be sorry you did. Highly Recommended- 2 👍🏻👍🏻thumbs way up.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Great everyday tee with a flattering oversized fit (petite-friendly)Great everyday tee with a flattering oversized fit (petite-friendly)
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I’ve been really happy with this t-shirt and ended up purchasing it in a second color after trying the first one. The fit is oversized, but in a flattering way—it doesn’t look sloppy or overly boxy. I ordered my usual size and it gave me that relaxed look without feeling too big.For reference, I’m 5’1, and the length works well on a petite frame. It has a slightly cropped cut, but it still provides enough coverage, especially when paired with high-waisted shorts or jeans. It hits at a comfortable spot and doesn’t feel too short.The fabric is soft and lightweight, making it great for everyday wear, especially in warmer weather. I’ve washed it multiple times now and haven’t noticed any shrinking, stretching, or pilling, which is always a concern with basic tees.Overall, this has become one of my go-to casual tops because it’s easy to style, comfortable, and holds up well. I’d recommend it if you’re looking for a relaxed-fit basic that still looks put together. I do feel it looks best tucked in.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Very Comfortable and Well Designed Oversized Crop Tee
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: This is a tee I own in multiple colors. I like my tees loose and comfortable with some updated style. This one fits the bill.  I probably should wear a medium but bought the large because I like how the extra volume drapes at the sides. It’s cropped in the middle of the front and back but because it’s basically a rectangle shape, the extra fabric at both sides fall lower on both sides. So on me the middle is right above my hip and the sides fall below the hip. It’s a very flattering shape which covers many a figure flaw! I think it really is true tips size but because of the oversized cut is forgiving if you want it smaller or larger.The sleeves fall below my elbows and have a great semi gathered cuff. This is an ok fabric. I wish it had a higher cotton content as it is a tad too thick for very hot summer days. It’s loose so it provides great air flow but I it’s too heavy in my opinion to work well in the very hot summer sun. The fabric feels like it’s predominantly polyester. It’s soft enough but I fear it may pill as time goes on. That said I bought it in five colors!

These kinds of long-sleeve tops are popular because they can be layered or worn alone for casual or slightly dressy outfits.  ￼The only small downside is that sizing can vary a little depending on the style, so checking the size chart is important before ordering. Some shoppers mention fit differences between pieces, which is something to keep in mind.  ￼Overall, this is a cute, versatile top that’s comfortable and easy to style. For the price and everyday wearability, I’d definitely buy another one in a different color.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Didn't work for my body type, but good piece overall
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Good quality print and lovely color. But I wouldn't put it in the dryer (ever) in order to preserve the pattern and fabric integrity. Typical of this price point / fast fashion in general, so no stars off. My advice is to lay flat to dry.I returned mine because the style is REALLY unflattering on my body type: a small-chested A-cup top with a Large middle. I'm 5'6" and 150-155 lbs, usually size medium/large top (med in the shoulder, but large belly), and I'm a large/12 bottom. I ordered medium and it fit well, but I looked absolutely pregnant in this shirt. Despite all the style advice out there to get a peplum-like top to accentuate my (nonexistent?) chest and supposedly draw attention away from my stomach, this did NOT work. Although, no stars were removed because the top never made such a claim.The color I got was the "Flower Black", which is a brown and cream floral print on black background. This is a great lowkey goth piece. Really liked the print. This would work for your closet goth and office goth in a business casual setting, as well as all you normies out there for fall through winter. Super pretty color.

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I couldn't wait to order this shirt based on the pretty photo, but the reality is a bit different. The fabric is stretchy and soft, albeit a little thin. It has a horizontal stripe texture that adds interest to an otherwise straightforward design. I ordered mine with the cuffs and collar in a different color, because I never wear tops that are all one color. The reason is that I don't like wearing jewelry, and solid-color tops need something (like jewelry) to break up that wall of color.One thing I don't like about this shirt is that it's about a foot too long. I like to wear my shirts untucked, but this is not loose and/or flowy, so wearing it untucked results in a bunched-up look where it clings at the waist or hips. That, or you have to keep pulling it down so it lies straight. This shirt would best be worn tucked in, which is a point against it for me personally. Another minor issue is the width of the cuffs. They would be much more flattering if they were about the same width as the collar. As it is, the cuffs are so wide as to almost be cartoonish. I solved this by rolling them back on themselves so they're half the width. Luckily the sleeves are long enough that this is possible.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: My new go-to brand for cozy, colorful, don’t-want-to-take-it-off comfortMy new go-to brand for cozy, colorful, don’t-want-to-take-it-off comfort
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: This pullover from Dokotoo (yes, that’s how you spell it—trust the vowels) is exactly the kind of surprise you hope for when ordering clothes online: flattering, cozy, and so good I now want it in every color.Let’s start with the fit: true to size. Not kind-of-true, not close-enough-to-fudge-it-true—actually true. That alone is worth a star or two in today’s online sizing lottery.The color I chose was “peacock blue,” though on arrival it leaned a little greener than expected. It’s beautiful. Vibrant, rich, and even nicer in person. The fabric? Soft, breathable, and stretchy in just the right way (95% polyester, 5% spandex)—a blend I don’t usually go for, but in this case, I’ve been thoroughly converted.Bonus points for construction: the ribbed cuffs and neckline are well finished, and the hem has a subtle puff to it, which adds a gentle, elevated touch. You could wear this around the house or out for errands and feel equally good either way. (And yes, I’ve already added another to my cart. That should tell you everything.)Wash note: I treat mine gently—wash regular, dry halfway, then hang to finish. Just because it hasn’t shrunk doesn’t mean I’m taking chances. Like any trusted companion, this sweatshirt deserves a little TLC.In short: Dokotoo has quietly become one of my favorite Amazon brands. I own eight of their tops in one style, a few in another, and now this one is joining the lineup. Reliable sizing, appealing colors, comfy fabric, and a flattering fit? That’s a win. Or rather, a Dokotoo.

The material feels fine and is light weight enough for working in a business-casual office in North Carolina.However, I'm not wild about how it looks on me... being oversized, it really makes you look bigger than you are and makes you look "oval" on top... not a flattering look.In addition, the material snags easily -- if you have a cat that likes to sit on your lap -- better not wear this sweater because after one time, I have about 1/2 a dozen snags which is disappointing!If it looked as cute on me as it does in the picture, it would be a good value for the money... but between the fact that it is easily snagged and the fact that it makes me look like I'm shaped like a Zeppelin means it's (at best) a sleep shirt and at worst, total waste of money.[LCAR]

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Super cut shirts that are a great value
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: LOVE these tops! They are actually 95% cotton and 5% elastane and are a great value!  The fabric is soft, holds its shape well and is very comfortable against my skin. I bought 3 colors and the sizing is consistent. I am 5'1", 138 lbs, a 36DD and got a medium, which is my usual size. The fit is roomy without being sloppy. I also could have ordered a size small for a closer but still slightly roomy fit. The only issue with them is the stripes do not match at the seams, but the way it is done looks intentional. It doesn't really detract from the look but if that bugs you, I would stay away.  I wore two of them to work, and received many complements.  I have not washed them yet so I don't know how they will wash.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Adorable shirt - but material definitely is flawed!
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I really like this shirt, even though I think the material is defective. The colors are great. I purchased several in size large because I like my shirts loose (I'm really a medium).  I can wear it with leggings, shorts, cropped or full length pants. It looks ribbed, but it feels silky and smooth. My two favorite colors are the hot pink and the grey blue. My mom has two of them also. (Reasonably priced.) Lots of compliments on the shirt! And I can wear a cardigan over them if I"m in air conditioned—the color block looks good with a solid color cardigan.     HOWEVER, I've seen the same thing that some other reviewers have pointed out. The material doesn't just snag easily, it looks snagged in spots when it arrives. But it's not snagged; it is some kind of defect in the ribbing. So if you somebody was inches away from you, they might see a snagged material look. So if you like perfection, this shirt is probably not for you. I'm going more for the overall look (and on Zoom calls it looks interesting too). It washes well, but my guess is these shirts (ranging currently between $8-$15) wont' last too long. But for the price, it's fine. Looks really nice, it's unique, and SO comfortable.

Does this fit true to size? 
Customers love the Trendy Queen Cute Summer Top! Material & Comfort – soft, high-quality, cool, comfortable. Style & Appearance – cute, flattering. Fit – true to size, relaxed, size down for fitted. Overall, happy with quality and style. 
Why you might like this? 
•Cozy Material – Soft rayon-spandex blend feels cool and breathable 
•Flattering Cut – Customers mention it's cute and flattering, perfect for casual outings and social events 
•Versatile – Works for spring and summer wear with multiple color options 
How should I care for this top? 
Here's how to care for the Trendy Queen Short Sleeve Shirts: Machine wash in a laundry bag on gentle cycle with cold water. Do not tumble dry on high heat. gentle cycle protects delicate material. Cold water prevents fading. Hang dry or lay flat. 
Does it work for all body types? 
The Trendy Queen Off the Shoulder Top works well for most body types. The loose design works best for: Apple & Pear – waist defines curves. Petite Frames – The cropped length is flattering. Straight Figures – The waist-hugging detail adds dimension. 
Is this suitable for work settings? 
Not really. The Trendy Queen Going Out Top is a casual, trendy piece and may not meet most workplace dress codes. The off-shoulder neckline and crop style are better for casual outings, dating, or social events rather than professional office.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: PRETTYGARDEN Womens Boat Neck Basic Short Sleeve Top
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I absolutely love this PRETTYGARDEN boat neck top! The fabric is soft, lightweight, and comfortable enough to wear all day. The boat neckline gives it a classic, polished look, while the short sleeves make it perfect for warmer weather or layering under a cardigan or jacket.The fit is flattering without being too tight, and it pairs effortlessly with jeans, shorts, skirts, or dress pants. It looks much more expensive than it is, and the quality exceeded my expectations. After several washes, the material has held up well and kept its shape and color.If you're looking for a versatile basic that's comfortable, stylish, and easy to dress up or down, this top is a fantastic choice. I'll definitely be purchasing it in more colors!
productPageReviews.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on August 1, 2026

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Flattering, Comfortable, and Great ValueFlattering, Comfortable, and Great Value
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I love these tops so much that I've purchased them in multiple colors, and I'm already considering buying even more! The fit is incredibly flattering without being too tight, and they pair well with everything from jeans to skirts and shorts, as well as business casual seperates for work.The boat neckline is one of my favorite features. It's feminine and stylish without being too revealing. I also really like the sleeve length, which provides just the right amount of coverage while still feeling light and comfortable for warmer weather.The quality is excellent for the price, and they've held up well after washing. I hang dry for maximum longevity and steammif needed. These tops are an easy wardrobe staple that can be dressed up or down depending on the occasion.My only minor complaint is the tag on the left side seam. It irritated my skin, and even after cutting it off, I could still feel the remaining portion of the tag. It's definitely a little annoying, but not nearly enough to keep me from wearing the tops or purchasing more colors.Overall, these are comfortable, flattering, versatile tops at a great price. Despite the tag issue, I would absolutely buy them again and highly recommend them.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: A little long, but otherwise, hard to beat!A little long, but otherwise, hard to beat!
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: There is a lot to like about these tops! The material is comfortable and looks like decent quality, I LOVE the neckline and sleeve cut, and they have a flattering fit. They are versatile enough for working out, business casual, or lounging around (I do think it’s a bit of a stretch to call them “going-out tops,” but to each their own). I was delighted at how not-sheer the fabric was for lighter colors (bought both white and cream); while you can see outlines, it’s pretty minimal for what I was expecting from a $10 top.My one gripe with these shirts: the length. I realize it may be what some are looking for - if you want butt-covering length, these are for you. I did realize they’d be longer than the tucked-look of the front picture, but didn’t realize how much. I chose these for a loose-fit gym option…and with the length they are, don’t love them for that; I wish they were 6” shorter. I’m seriously debating cutting the bottoms, but am concerned I’ll be ruining them if the unfinished hem starts rolling up. I know I could knot them, but that is often uncomfortable in practice when using certain workout equipment. I wanted something loose and longer than crop top length, but not this much longer. Even if you are tucking the shirt, there’s a lot of length to have to shove somewhere.That said - this isn’t the fault of the shirt or manufacturer, I think they’re fairly advertised and I just had different hopes. (And it didn’t stop me from buying several more after trying the first one). To be honest, it’s probably good to have some longer options in my closet, and for the price, I think these are hard to beat.I did start off ordering a medium, as recommended, but felt like it was a little too loose for what I wanted and tried a small, which I thought was great (and then ordered 5 more). For reference, I’m 5’6”, upper 130s, athletic, and a 34B (usually in a bralette or sports bra). I just didn’t think I needed the extra room in the chest and waist that the medium gave (it looked kind of sloppy from a profile view). In the photos, the blue green top is the medium and the white is the small. (The small also seemed to knock a tiny bit of the unwanted length off, but not much.)All in all, I think these are an easy yes for most people’s wardrobe, great to have as staples in basic colors for layering or easily elevating a t-shirt look. If I roll the dice and try the self-cropping, I will update, but I feel like my hesitation to do so, even at the low price point, speaks to the quality of the shirts.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Love the Fabric and Color, Order Smaller
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: This is such a cute top.The fabric is one of my favorite things about it. It feels nice, drapes well, and the color is gorgeous in person. I also love the length. I am not a fan of tops that are super long, and this one hits at just the right spot without feeling cropped to the extreme.I do not put most of my clothes in the dryer, so I cannot speak to that, but it has washed well and held up nicely.A couple of things to know before ordering. It is a little lower cut than I expected, but a simple cami underneath solves that easily. I would also strongly recommend sizing down. I ordered my usual size and it was much roomier than I wanted. Looking back, I would have gone down at least one size, maybe even two, depending on the fit you are after.Overall, it is a flattering, easy to wear top with beautiful color and fabric. I just wish I had ordered a smaller size.

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I’m really impressed with this Saodimallsu summer top! The cap sleeves and loose fit make it incredibly comfortable and breathable, perfect for hot days. The quality is better than I expected for the price—no pilling, stretching, or fading after several washes.If you’re looking for a casual, airy top for summer that’s stylish and comfortable, this one is a winner. It’s quickly become a staple in my warm-weather wardrobe!

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Cute elevated basic that works dressed up or casual
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I really like this shirt because it has the comfort of a basic T-shirt but looks a little more polished because of the textured fabric. It’s easy to wear with jeans or shorts, but I could also see it working well with dress pants for a casual work outfit.The material is lightweight and has a nice amount of stretch without feeling flimsy. I also like the sleeve length and the way the shirt falls through the midsection—it’s comfortable without looking shapeless.One thing I especially appreciate is that the texture adds some interest without making the shirt feel heavy or too warm. It’s a good option if you want something simple that still looks more put together than a plain tee.Overall, this has turned into an easy everyday top for me. I’d recommend it for anyone looking for a comfortable shirt that can easily go from casual to slightly dressier outfits.
productPageReviews.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on August 15, 2026

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I really like this ribbed knit striped women’s top! As someone who is petite, I also appreciated that it fit well without looking oversized.It washes well, keeps its shape, and still looks nice after drying. Overall, this is a simple but versatile top that works well for casual outings, errands, or everyday wear.
